title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. My mother who is 61 years old want to perform Hajj but I don't get the leave for 40 days, so please confirm she can go with her niece & niece’s husband or any other way to perform Hajj without mahram. We can't go through private due to financial problem. 2573 views Q. I am from India, last week i and my friend went to perform Umrah. We performed the Umrah two times with an interval of 3 hours. 1. After completion of first Umrah i get shaved my head but my friend get trim his hair about 1 inch. 2. After completion of second Umrah we went directly to our hotel and removed the Ahraam(Dress). Please guide whether we did right or in which terms we did wrong and what we had to do, now what should we do. 2406 views Q. If someone says Talbiyah during Tawaf (May it be Tawaf of Umrah or Hajj) due to ignorance or forgetfully, then is there any affect on validity of Tawaf, Umrah or Hajj? 2410 views Q. Taking leave for Hajj 4012 views Q. I am 56 years old and planning, inshallah, to travel for Umrah this Ramzan along with my wife. answer: Prayers & Duties >> Hajj & Umrah Question ID: 9023 Country: Saudi Arabia Title: asalamualaykum mufti sahib I Belong to U.P.(India), working in Saudi Arabia & planning to perform HAJJ. When my father was sick ,two years ago, I lend some money for treating him and at the time of coming Saudi Arabia I again lend some money from another person and did?t pay so far.Both the person never demand their money.My question is if I perform Hajj after granting their permission with this promise that I will pay the money after perform Hajj and they agree ,it will be a valid Hajj accordance with the islamic principles or requirements or not. Jazakallahukhaira. Question: asalamualaykum mufti sahib I Belong to U.P.(India), working in Saudi Arabia & planning to perform HAJJ. When my father was sick ,two years ago, I lend some money for treating him and at the time of coming Saudi Arabia I again lend some money from another person and did?t pay so far.Both the person never demand their money.My question is if I perform Hajj after granting their permission with this promise that I will pay the money after perform Hajj and they agree ,it will be a valid Hajj accordance with the islamic principles or requirements or not. Jazakallahukhaira. Answer ID: 9023 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 2037/1885=D/1429) It is better for you to intend for hajj after paying off the debt. Yes, if the creditor is ready and you can easily pay your debt after performing hajj then you can perform the hajj before paying your debt as well, the hajj will be valid, but you should take respite from the creditors. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
